$comment: Client-side validation constants for the top-level create-order fields; the single source of truth shared by the five language SDKs.
Extracted from the gateway's request validators and checked by hand.
required_text_fields: plain-text fields the gateway marks as required; non-empty after trimming whitespace is enough.
amount_pattern: the gateway's amount format plus the DECIMAL(18,2) limit (16 integer digits, 2 decimals);
amount must also be a string and greater than zero. Those two checks are hard-coded in each language's validator, not here.
webhook_url_prefix: the gateway requires a URL starting with https://, matched case-insensitively.
To change a constant edit this file only and regenerate the per-language tables so all five languages update together;
the vectors in protocol/testdata/validation/ are verified by every language's test suite.
